page.layout: One column of running text, with the running head and page number at the top right. No marginal notes. The catchword "sit" sits at the bottom right.

main_text.p: quo magis suum ageret offi-cium. Respondeo enim, hoc tum demum procedere, quan-do quis alteri operam defen-sionis locat ad vitae dies, vel ad-certum tempus; quod citra turpitudinis notam permis-sum est, atque licitum. Neque enim quispiam tenetur, nisi qui forte est de famulitio, ali-quem perpetuo comitari, aut ejusdem curam gerere, nisi ad hoc datâ mercede, aut promisso honorario, vel conductus sit, vel gratis suam operam ad-dixerit. Verùm hic non est ca-sus propositus, quando fortui-to & casualiter quispiam in manus latronum incidit, qui illius vitae insidiantur. Tunc enim qui non juvat & tuetur periclitantem, etiam si de mer-cede, aut salario conventum non sit, æquè tenetur, ac si vim innocenti intulisset.

page.notes: The text "Neque obstat.2." keeps the printed superscript 2 as it appears in the line. The line-end hyphenations (ca-sus, fortui-to, mer-cede, ad-dixerit) are kept as printed. The "ad-" before "certum" is hard to confirm at the line end and may be unhyphenated in print. Long s is rendered as s throughout; the printed "f" forms (e.g. "fuum", "eft", "permiffum") are transcribed as suum, est, permissum.
